deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O0b Welcome 1/2/3': slide copy differs on every slide. Frame: 1 'Your books, kept properly / Real double-entry underneath, without asking you to know any accounting.' · 2 'Your family, on the same page / Everyone who shares the money sees the same books, and who entered what.' · 3 'Sealed to everyone else / Even we cannot open them. That is why there is no password.' App: 1 'Your books, always with you / Cash, bank, parties — one place, on your phone' · 2 'No password, no risk / Your books are locked so well that even we can't open them' · 3 'Family and business, together / Share what you choose, keep the rest private'
deviations.reason: [screen] the ARB strings (onboarding.welcome.slide*) predate DESIGN-PACK O0b, which rules the three ideas and their order exactly as the frame draws them; the app's slide 2 also drops 'that is why there is no password'
deviations.authority: design/DESIGN-PACK.md §O0b (ranks with the numbered specs, CLAUDE.md § Precedence)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: each slide has a line-drawn navy illustration above the title (a ruled two-page book · three people · a padlock); the app draws no illustration
deviations.reason: [screen] no illustration assets exist; DESIGN-PACK O0b asks for one line drawing per slide

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: title and body are left-aligned at the screen gutter, the body in the muted colour at ~15 px with loose leading; the app centres both and draws the body in full ink
deviations.reason: [screen] _WelcomeSlide uses TextAlign.center and the default body colour

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: the page dots are an elongated ink pill for the current slide and two pale dots; the app draws three equal 8 px circles, the current one navy (primary) and the others mid-grey (muted)
deviations.reason: [screen] page indicator is local to this screen (no shared component)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: 'Skip' is a quiet muted label at the top right; the app draws it as a navy (primary) TextButton at label weight
deviations.reason: [shared] tertiary text button colour (TextButton theme): the canvas draws dismiss/skip/later actions in muted ink throughout (also c1 O7a 'Not now', c1 O7b 'Later')

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: the Next / Get started button is square-cornered, ~52 px tall, full width inside a ~20 px gutter; the app's is ~48 px tall, rounded, inside a 24 px inset
deviations.reason: [shared] primary button (FilledButton theme, app/lib/shared/theme.dart): ~48 px tall with RkRadius corners, inset by the ~24 px screen padding
deviations.authority: design/tokens/tokens.json radius + the canvas's button component; ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (the frame decides components)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: the title/body block sits in the middle third with the illustration above; the app's title sits higher-centre with nothing above it, so vertical rhythm differs on every slide
deviations.reason: [screen] follows from the missing illustration and the centred layout

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0b Welcome 1/2/3: body text is set wider than the frame's at the same size (letter-spaced)
deviations.reason: [shared] theme text styles (app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme): Material's inherited letterSpacing (0.5 bodyLarge, 0.25 bodyMedium, 0.1–0.5 labels) is never zeroed, so every run of body/label text is wider than the canvas's untracked Mukta
deviations.authority: tokens.json type.scale carries no tracking; open item from the S0.8 record (KEY145B review finding 4); ADR 2026-10-05 §1
